mass_conversion_basis: phenylbutyrate-anion and free-acid-equivalent sensitivity; label does not specify plasma assay mass calibration; neither uses administered sodium-salt mass186.2
model: post-peak one-exponential decay only; no absorption, repeated dosing, tissue partition, intracellular pharmacodynamics or patient predictions
inference: deterministic exposure requirements and assumption sensitivity; no inferential P values
pk_range_scope: ranges of reported means, not bounds on individual or population exposure
